theme_and_archetype.rationale: Authority, clarity, and function-first. A workshop app demands absolute precision, high legibility for numbers/prices, and fast daily operations without decorative clutter. Color is used strictly for function.

rules.anti_pattern_avoided: No Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings. No centered text by default. Use tabular-nums for all prices and stock quantities.

rules.accents: Color is function. Do not use generic gradients. 95% of the UI is monochrome/structural. Primary blue is for main actions (Pay, Save), Red is for destructive/low stock warnings.

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing. Minimum p-6 for container padding. Minimum h-14 for all touch targets.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Mode B: The Control Room Grid (Mobile-First)

rules.containers: Solid background, 1px subtle border (#D1D5DB), 0 shadow. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
rules.alignment: Strictly left-aligned content. Asymmetry creates tension. Do not center-everything.
rules.cashier_layout: Split screen or sticky bottom sheet on mobile for Cart vs Item Selection.
rules.dashboard_menu: Bento-style grid. 2 columns on mobile. Bold typography and icons.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0033FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0022CC] h-14 px-8 font-bold tracking-wide rounded-sm transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] h-14 px-8 font-bold hover:bg-[#F4F5F7] rounded-sm
buttons.danger: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white hover:bg-[#D72621] h-14 px-8 font-bold rounded-sm

inputs.style: h-14 bg-[#F4F5F7] border-b-2 border-[#D1D5DB] rounded-none px-4 focus:border-[#0033FF] focus:outline-none transition-colors text-base font-medium
inputs.labels: uppercase text-xs tracking-widest text-[#4B5563] mb-2 block

cards_and_lists.style: bg-white border border-[#D1D5DB] p-6 mb-4 rounded-sm hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform
cards_and_lists.inventory_item: Flex row. Left side: Item Name (Chivo) & Category. Right side: Price & Stock (tabular-nums). If stock < 5, apply red text.
cards_and_lists.transaction_item: Flex row. Left side: Date & Customer. Right side: Total (Green if Paid, Red if Unpaid).

navigation.header: Sticky top, bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#D1D5DB] h-16 flex items-center px-4 z-50
navigation.bottom_tab: Sticky bottom for primary actions in Cashier view (e.g., massive PAY button).

login_register.layout: Full screen split or stacked. Top: Stark workshop image with bg-black/50 overlay. Bottom: Form.

dashboard.layout: Bento grid (Mode B). Large tap targets.
dashboard.items: Kasir (Cashier), Bon/Pencatatan Transaksi, Daftar Barang, Detail Bengkel, Detail Pengguna.

kasir.layout: List of available items/services + persistent cart summary at bottom.
kasir.features: Input barang/jasa, quantity, discount, payment method, total calculation, print/download simple receipt. Use large bold numbers for TOTAL.

bon_transaksi.features: Date, customer, items, total, status (Paid/Unpaid), invoice number, notes, mechanic.

daftar_barang.features: Name, category, price, stock, supplier, item code, visual warning for low stock (Signal Red block or icon).

detail_pengguna.features: Admin, Kasir, Mekanik. High contrast badges (e.g., Admin = Blue, Kasir = Black, Mekanik = Grey).

images.description: Dimly lit mechanic working, overlaid with high-contrast text and solid form.
Well-equipped modern garage, use as abstract header banner with heavy black/40 overlay.

icons.style: Duotone or Bold weight. High contrast.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements must include data-testid

motion_and_interactions.rule: Minimalist. Snap responses. Function over form.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit text color changes on hover (e.g., hover:bg-[#0022CC] hover:text-white). Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1).
motion_and_interactions.focus: High contrast ring focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0033FF] focus:outline-none.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the JSON rules. Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto' fonts. Import Chivo and IBM Plex Sans via Google Fonts.
Ensure the app is built mobile-first. Use large tap targets (h-14) since users (mechanics/cashiers) operate in fast-paced physical environments.
Implement the Swiss grid: sharp corners, solid 1px borders, structural greyscale with stark International Klein Blue (#0033FF) for primary actions.
Ensure all numbers (stock, prices, totals) use tabular-nums (font-mono) for alignment.
Always apply 'data-testid' to actionable items and values as specified.
